# Sachin Industries

> Sheet metal laser cutting, bending and shearing in Bhosari, Pune, Maharashtra, India.

## Business facts
- Over 30 years of experience.
- Fiber laser: 12 kW, 8,000 × 2,500 mm working bed, up to 40 mm cutting thickness.
- Bending: up to 25 mm thickness and 8 metres length.
- Shearing: up to 25 mm thickness and 8 metres length.
- All maximums depend on material and part geometry. Maximum length and thickness must not be assumed achievable together. Contact the team for job-specific confirmation.
- Address: S-68, MIDC, Bhosari, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Pune 411026, Maharashtra, India.
- Email: sachinindustries1660@gmail.com
- Sachin Agarwal: +91 94220 27396. Sumeet Agarwal: +91 98813 33501.

Free 2D CAD: /cad.html
CAD commands, file formats and limits: /cad-guide.html
Sachin CAD is an independent browser drafting tool: DXF import/export, precise coordinates, layers, dimensions and sheet-metal helpers. No account required; drawings remain on the visitor device. It is not AutoCAD and does not support DWG or CAM.
3D illustrations are stylised process studies, not dimensionally exact digital twins.
